dlentry.dd: A topic of the same type in the same place in the map, for an earlier generation.
The values, statements and tables for a new generation, each with a source ID.
A value defined once in a map and pulled into topics with keyref.
A Gemini API setting that makes the model return JSON that matches a JSON Schema.
The DITA draft-comment element. AlignR uses it for open questions.
A topic outline with questions, for a topic that has no sibling.
The share of tokens a writer must change to turn a draft into the published topic.
A generation whose published topics AlignR doesn't read while drafting, so they can grade the drafts.
A draft made by copying the most recent sibling and swapping its keys, with no model. The checks run on it too.
